digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent guidance and Rebar tracker integration
propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack local clone, direct Gerrit access, shell network access, or mounted Rebar tracker despite having GitHub connector and repository visibility, creating a capability gap where existing agent guidance does not explain safe operations or when ticket creation cannot be completed natively.

The import mechanism must enforce strict validation of required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) and detect malformed records via record-count comparison in dry-run mode, since missing ticket_id/ticket_type records are silently skipped without counter increments or warnings in that mode.

Native ticket creation is impossible only when the tracker-worktree dimension fails AND (network/remote dimension fails OR native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable); any other capability combination does not trigger the fallback path.

Fallback ticket payloads must conform to export.schema.json's actual required fields with agent-generated UUID4 ticket_id (which becomes source_id on import) and status: open, enabling idempotent re-import without duplication.

ChatGPT guidance must require search-before-create, prohibit hand-authoring or mutating event files (due to append-only invariant), document GitHub as read-only mirror with Gerrit as the code-change workflow, and explicitly state that GitHub Issues are not a Rebar tracker substitute.

The only sanctioned exceptional import path is rebar import (or rebar.import_tickets()) consuming NDJSON compiled-state projections with fresh local ids/HLC timestamps; never raw event-file injection or GitHub Contents API writes to the tickets branch.
